_comment: Atlas's last stand (D191, replacing D73's tour): a new player's first game. It is the last day of Atlas's own world, in Hearthwick (data/areas/tutorial.json), run by src/ui/tutorial_guide.gd: the game's ways taught one step at a time, then a fight Atlas cannot win. He falls for good: he is written into the record of the fallen (src/chronicle/sixteen.gd) and his world is the first that ended, so the next lead is picked by the quiz, the opening shows his world going dark, his ghost sits at the fire and his weapon falls into the next world. Each step is done when its `done` happens: `did` (what EventBus.player_did says; a value ending in ':' or '_' matches any name), `flag` (set in GameState), `opened` ('party' or 'journal'), or `button`. A step may have `on_start` → `set_flag` (a list), set as it comes up: the fight steps call out the village's bands (`bands` in its area, D75). The step with `doom` is the last: when its fight ends, `fall` is shown and Atlas is written down. Nothing else here is saved.

steps.title: The last day of Atlas's world
steps.text:
You are Atlas, one of the sixteen, in the world that is his. Learn its ways here: walking, talking, trading, fighting.

Nothing you do in Hearthwick is saved. What happens to Atlas is.

steps.title: Walking
steps.text:
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or click the ground to walk there. Your company follows the leader.

The mouse wheel zooms; the line along the bottom always says what you can do where you stand.

steps.title: Talking
steps.text: Anyone with a ! over them has something to say. Walk up to Maren the Guide, by the signpost, and click her (or stand close and press E).

steps.title: Asking questions
steps.text: Conversations give you replies to pick. Ask Maren something: what the gates are, what the Tower is, what happens when someone falls.

steps.title: Buying
steps.text: Pim keeps the stall. Ask what he's selling and buy something: food and draughts heal between fights, and gear makes your people stronger. Your gold is in the party screen.

steps.title: Not everyone wants to talk
steps.text: Smudge, the fox in the hat, won't speak to you. Some people need a coin, a good roll, or a reason. Find a way round it.

steps.title: Doing a favour
steps.text: People ask for help. Ask Wren if she needs a hand, find what she lost — things worth a look are marked ? — then go back and tell her.

steps.title: Chests
steps.text: There's a chest by the cart. Walk onto it to open it. Each one opens once, and what's inside is yours.

steps.title: Doors
steps.text: Walk into a door. Some houses you can go inside — the inn has people of its own — and some are shut and say why. Come back out the way you went in.

steps.title: Your company
steps.text: Press P for the party screen: everyone's health, gear and abilities, and where you choose a class when someone is ready to grow. Close it with Esc.

steps.title: The journal
steps.text: Press N for the journal: every creature you've met, the roads you've walked and the story of your run so far.

steps.title: A sparring fight
steps.text:
Captain Harrow's sparring pair are out in the field south of the square now. The red cells are what they can see, and they move as the pair patrols. Step into the red and the fight starts right there, on this ground. Long grass hides you, and bursting out of it at them is an ambush.

Space pauses and unpauses it. Left-click or drag a box to pick fighters; right-click to move or attack. Q W E R use skills. Nobody can die in practice.

steps.title: What lies beyond Hearthwick
steps.text:
Every world of the sixteen is like this one. The land is a map you walk across, black until you've been there: villages and keeps to rest and trade in, libraries that teach, huts, the Adventurers Guild with paid contracts, and the gates, where monsters pour out. Bands patrol with their red ground showing, like the sparring pair. Shut a gate by fighting through it; leave one open too long and it breaks.

The Tower rises over everything, a hundred floors of it.

steps.title: The gate in the hills breaks
steps.text:
A gate nobody shut has broken. What was behind it is coming down the road into Hearthwick, its red ground ahead of it.

Atlas cannot beat it. Fight it anyway: step into the red. In Earth Kings a fall is for good — when your lead dies, their world ends with them.

lines: Atlas falls in Hearthwick, and does not get up.
With him goes his world: the village, the road, the Tower over it, all of it going dark.
That is how it is for the sixteen. One life, one world. When a lead dies, their world ends, and the next of them begins again in another, knowing only what you learned.

skip.title: Atlas's last stand
skip.text: You've played Atlas's last stand before. Play it again, or skip it? Skipped, he still falls: the run begins with the next of the sixteen.
